benefit_plan_valid.name: benefit_plan_valid
benefit_plan_valid.value: "benefit_plan"."price_cents" between 1 and 999999999 and "benefit_plan"."included_uses" between 0 and 1000 and "benefit_plan"."price_cents" >= "benefit_plan"."included_uses" and "benefit_plan"."tax_basis_points" between 0 and 10000 and "benefit_plan"."discount_basis_points" between 0 and 10000 and cardinality("benefit_plan"."service_ids") between 1 and 100 and "benefit_plan"."version">0 and (("benefit_plan"."kind"='package' and "benefit_plan"."included_uses">0 and "benefit_plan"."period_months" is null and "benefit_plan"."discount_basis_points"=0 and ("benefit_plan"."validity_days" is null or "benefit_plan"."validity_days" between 1 and 3650)) or ("benefit_plan"."kind"='membership' and "benefit_plan"."period_months" between 1 and 12 and "benefit_plan"."validity_days" is null and ("benefit_plan"."included_uses">0 or "benefit_plan"."discount_basis_points">0)))

pass_period_valid.name: pass_period_valid

pass_unit_valid.name: pass_unit_valid

checkout_reward_valid.name: checkout_reward_valid
